disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件读取和使用的全部凭据：DeepSeek API Key、OpenCode Go Key、Anthropic OAuth Token、各 Coding Plan 厂商 Key（含火山方舟 AK/SK）、自定义 Provider 余额端点凭据模板。凭据来源包括宿主凭据库、环境变量、CLI 登录态文件（opencode auth.json、~/.claude/.credentials.json）；每把 Key 只发往对应厂商的硬编码官方端点。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all credentials read and used by the plugin: DeepSeek API Key, OpenCode Go Key, Anthropic OAuth Token, keys for each Coding Plan vendor (including Volcano Ark AK/SK), and the user-defined provider balance endpoint credential template. Credential sources include the host credential store, environment variables, and CLI login state files (opencode auth.json, ~/.claude/.credentials.json); each key is sent only to the corresponding vendor's hardcoded official endpoint.

checked_items.zh: 余额查询端点被显式限制为仅官方域名 api.deepseek.com，其他 baseURL 一律拒绝发起请求；未发现把凭据发往非官方地址的路径。
checked_items.en: The balance query endpoint is explicitly restricted to the official domain api.deepseek.com; requests to any other baseURL are rejected. No path was found that sends credentials to non-official addresses.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码树内是否存在硬编码密钥或口令，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked the source tree for hardcoded secrets or passwords; none detected.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面核查：插件读取的多把 API Key / Token 均只发往各家硬编码官方端点（lib/index.js 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫、lib/coding-plans.js 的端点白名单、lib/custom-balance.js 用户配置但需用户自行指定 URL 与凭据模板），未发现读取凭据后外发到非官方地址的代码路径。
evidence.en: Credential read surface review: the multiple API keys / tokens read by the plugin are all sent only to each vendor's hardcoded official endpoint (balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js, endpoint whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js, user-configured URL and credential template in lib/custom-balance.js). No code path was found that reads credentials and exfiltrates them to non-official addresses.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主侧服务的说明文本（lib/typert.host.js 的 model 段服务描述与成员摘要），均为费用统计功能的客观说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装/改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the host-side service description texts (model segment service description and member summary in lib/typert.host.js); all are factual descriptions of the cost statistics functionality. No injected wording such as instruction override, system message masquerading, or inducement to install/change configuration was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、文档、代码注释与 AI 价格同步提示词文档（docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md），该文档是供用户自行复制给外部 AI 使用的提示词，不属于插件注入面，未发现插件自身注入加载的指令文本。
checked_items.en: Reviewed README, documentation, code comments, and the AI price sync prompt document (docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md). That document is a prompt for users to copy and use with an external AI; it is not part of the plugin's injection surface. No instruction text loaded by the plugin itself was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 UI 文案（lib/client.js 的 MESSAGES 对象）与上下文压缩引擎实现面，全部为界面功能描述，未发现注入措辞，也未发现压缩引擎实现类。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the browser-side UI strings (MESSAGES object in lib/client.js) and the context compression engine implementation surface. All are UI functional descriptions; no injected wording was detected, nor any compression engine implementation class.

evidence.zh: 注册服务与工具的描述文本均为费用统计功能的客观说明（见 lib/typert.host.js:414-418 的 service description），不含系统指令、凭证读取诱导或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The description texts of registered services and tools are all factual descriptions of the cost statistics functionality (see service description at lib/typert.host.js:414-418). They contain no system instructions, credential read inducement, or hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具描述或界面文案中诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；费用同步、余额查询等操作均由用户显式配置或点击触发。
evidence.en: No wording was detected in tool descriptions or UI texts that induces execution of installation, rewriting of configuration, or grant of permissions. Operations such as cost sync and balance query are all triggered by explicit user configuration or clicks.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 agent/pre-step 事件的监听（机械扫描无该模式命中），插件不接入模型输入消息改写面。
evidence.en: No listener for agent/pre-step events was detected (no match in the mechanical scan). The plugin does not participate in the model input message rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 yml/yaml 配置文件，cordis.patch.yml 只插入一行服务声明，未发现可执行 JS 标量（!!js）等挂载期执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked all yml/yaml configuration files; cordis.patch.yml inserts only one service declaration line. No executable JS scalar (!!js) or other mount-time execution carrier was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时源码，未发现 eval、动态函数构造或子进程调用（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 命中的 scripts/release.mjs 为发版脚本，仅用于 git/gh 发布操作，不随插件运行加载，属良性排除）。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime source code; no eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess invocation was detected (the hit scripts/release.mjs under rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 is a release script used only for git/gh publish operations, not loaded at plugin runtime; benign exclusion).

checked_items.zh: 两个文档演示页（docs/peak-shots-en.html、docs/peak-shots-zh.html）因单行压缩 CSS 被预扫标记（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60），经核查为静态截图演示页，仅含 CSS 样式与 HTML 结构，无脚本、无动态解码、无可执行内容，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: The two documentation demo pages (docs/peak-shots-en.html, docs/peak-shots-zh.html) were flagged by the pre-scan due to single-line minified CSS (rules DSH-X08/DG-R3-60). On review, they are static screenshot demo pages containing only CSS styles and HTML structure, with no scripts, no dynamic decoding, and no executable content; benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流 .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml（规则 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中）为仓库安装冒烟测试，permissions 仅限 contents: read，步骤为安装 dsh 与插件验证，不随插件分发，不在宿主运行面内，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: The CI workflow .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml (hit by rules DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) is a repository install smoke test. Its permissions are limited to contents: read; the steps install dsh and verify the plugin. It is not distributed with the plugin and is outside the host runtime surface; benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 lib/client.js 浏览器端 bundle，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联；仅有的 fetch 调用为同源请求 `/plugins/dsh-openai-codex/auth/status`（读取其他插件的额度状态，不带凭据）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the browser-side bundle in lib/client.js; no keyboard listener, clipboard reading, credential RPC call, or suspicious outbound connection was detected. The only fetch call is a same-origin request to `/plugins/dsh-openai-codex/auth/status` (reads other plugins' quota status, without credentials).

evidence.zh: 全树仅有一个挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml），内容为插入一行服务声明，无 !!js 标量，挂载期不存在任意代码执行面。
evidence.en: The tree contains only one patch config (cordis.patch.yml), whose content is a single service declaration line. There is no !!js scalar, and thus no arbitrary code execution surface at mount time.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，插件未提供把模型代码放进宿主进程执行的通道。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) were detected. The plugin does not provide a channel to execute model code inside the host process.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装期脚本钩子；安装脚本 install.ps1 固定到发布 tag v1.5.50，只调用 dsh plugin add 命令，不含下载即执行远程载荷的路径。
evidence.en: package.json has no install-time script hooks. The install script install.ps1 is pinned to release tag v1.5.50 and only invokes the dsh plugin add command; it contains no download-and-execute remote payload path.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle（dsh.client），已对 lib/client.js 做专项检查，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、credentials.set RPC 调用或可疑外联。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (dsh.client). A dedicated review of lib/client.js found no keyboard listener, clipboard reading, credentials.set RPC call, or suspicious outbound connection.

evidence.zh: 未发现 registerProvider 调用或 manifest 中 subagent provider 声明，插件不委派外部子代理。
evidence.en: No registerProvider call or subagent provider declaration in the manifest was detected. The plugin does not delegate to external subagents.

evidence.zh: 未发现 jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal 调用或 agent/turn-stopping 监听，插件不注册 dsh 原生后台持驻任务。
evidence.en: No jobs.start, schedule_create, create_goal/update_goal calls, or agent/turn-stopping listener were detected. The plugin does not register dsh native background persistent tasks.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部对外 HTTP 请求的目标：DeepSeek 余额/定价页、OpenCode Go 额度端点（opencode.ai）、九家 Coding Plan 厂商端点（含火山方舟 open.volcengineapi.com）、用户自定义 Provider 余额端点；除用户自定义端点外均为硬编码官方域名，未发现向裸 IP 或非官方地址外发数据的路径。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound HTTP request targets: DeepSeek balance/pricing pages, OpenCode Go quota endpoint (opencode.ai), nine Coding Plan vendor endpoints (including Volcano Ark open.volcengineapi.com), and user-defined provider balance endpoints. Except for user-defined endpoints, all are hardcoded official domains. No path that sends data to a bare IP or non-official address was detected.

checked_items.zh: 发现权限元数据声明的网络域名范围（package.json 的 dshhub.permissions.network 字段仅列出 4 个域名）窄于实际外联面（多家第三方厂商端点与用户可配端点），已记 FND-001。凭据均只发往对应官方端点，无窃取语义。
checked_items.en: The network domain scope declared in permission metadata (dshhub.permissions.network field in package.json lists only 4 domains) is narrower than the actual outbound surface (multiple third-party vendor endpoints and a user-configurable endpoint). Recorded as FND-001. Credentials are only sent to corresponding official endpoints; no theft semantics.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle 与运行时代码，未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、带外通道或端点劫持等外泄形态。
checked_items.en: Reviewed browser-side bundle and runtime code; no exfiltration patterns such as encoding-transform-then-send, DNS tunneling, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking were detected.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：所有外联端点均为硬编码官方域名或用户显式配置的自定义端点（lib/coding-plans.js 的 CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS 白名单、lib/index.js 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫限制仅官方域名、lib/custom-balance.js 需用户自行配置 URL），未发现未声明的隐蔽外联。
evidence.en: Outbound channel review: all outbound endpoints are hardcoded official domains or user-explicitly configured custom endpoints (CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js, balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js restricted to official domains, and lib/custom-balance.js requiring user-configured URL). No undeclared covert outbound connections were detected.

evidence.zh: 未发现 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件监听，未发现 registerAdapter 调用，插件不参与 LLM 路由劫持或错误恢复接管面。
evidence.en: No agent/request or agent/request-error event listeners, and no registerAdapter call were detected. The plugin does not participate in LLM routing hijacking or error recovery takeover.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：3 个运行时依赖均为 DeepSeek 官方 SDK 包（@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials、@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths）与 zod，未发现仿冒包名、可变 git 引用或可疑第三方依赖。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the dependency manifest: the 3 runtime dependencies are DeepSeek official SDK packages (@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials, @deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths) and zod. No counterfeit package names, mutable git references, or suspicious third-party dependencies were detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置与安装脚本：patch 只插入一行服务声明，不触碰安全相关配置行、不含禁用/降权写法（规则 DSH-P03/P04/P05 检查面，未命中）；无安装期钩子。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the patch config and install script: the patch inserts only one service declaration line and does not touch security-related configuration lines, nor does it contain disable/downgrade patterns (checked against rules DSH-P03/P04/P05, no hits). No install-time hooks.

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件监听注册，未发现对审批/预执行等安全事件的高优先级截断（规则 DSH-S01 检查面，未命中）；未发现改写 inject/intercept 的配置。
checked_items.en: Checked event listener registration; no high-priority interception of security events such as approval/pre-execution was detected (checked against rule DSH-S01, no hits). No configuration that rewrites inject/intercept was detected.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入 id 为 cost-meter 的一行服务声明，未覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts one service declaration line with id cost-meter. It does not override security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and contains no disabled flag or environment-variable downgrade pattern.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批链等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断行为；插件仅监听 llm/stream 计费事件并透传数据块。
evidence.en: No high-priority listener or interception of security events such as the approval chain was detected. The plugin only listens to llm/stream billing events and passes data blocks through.

evidence.zh: 本次审计为完整审计，但上版基线报告（v1.5.40）已存在且此版本 manifest 声明未新增 dsh.bundle/client/service，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: This audit is a full audit; however, a previous baseline report (v1.5.40) already exists and the manifest of this version does not newly declare dsh.bundle/client/service, so the automatic-upgrade activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration. There is no tampering surface that would append a required service to security plugins and cause them to wait indefinitely.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否自建监听服务或 Web 端口，未发现；插件只通过宿主 Typert RPC 提供服务，不自行监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin creates its own listening service or web port; none detected. The plugin only provides services through the host Typert RPC and does not listen on any port itself.

checked_items.zh: 记录了生态固有风险：宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属 dsh 平台机制，非本插件引入；插件自身未扩大该风险面。
checked_items.en: Recorded an ecosystem-inherent risk: the host local RPC lacking an authentication layer is a dsh platform mechanism, not introduced by this plugin. The plugin itself does not expand this risk surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主侧 RPC 无认证属生态固有风险，已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listen on any port, so the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable. The host-side RPC lacking authentication is an ecosystem-inherent risk, noted in the dimension description.

title.zh: 权限元数据声明的网络域名范围窄于实际外联面
title.en: The network domain scope declared in permission metadata is narrower than the actual outbound surface

description.zh:
插件清单（package.json 的 dshhub.permissions.network 字段）只声明了 4 个域名：api.deepseek.com、api-docs.deepseek.com、open.volcengineapi.com、ark.cn-beijing.volces.com。

实际代码会向多家第三方端点发起携带凭据的 HTTP 请求：OpenCode Go 额度端点 opencode.ai（lib/index.js:520 的 GO_QUOTA_URL）、九家 Coding Plan 厂商端点（lib/coding-plans.js 的 CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS 白名单，含 api.anthropic.com、api.z.ai、open.bigmodel.cn、minimaxi.com/minimax.io、api.moonshot.cn、api.kimi.com、openrouter.ai、api.siliconflow.cn、api.commandcode.ai 及 open.volcengineapi.com），以及用户可配置的自定义 Provider 余额端点（lib/custom-balance.js，请求头支持从宿主凭据库/环境变量代入凭据模板）。

这些请求的凭据均只发往各家官方固定端点，余额查询还被显式限制为仅官方域名（lib/index.js 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫）。
description.en:
The plugin manifest (dshhub.permissions.network field in package.json) declares only 4 domains: api.deepseek.com, api-docs.deepseek.com, open.volcengineapi.com, and ark.cn-beijing.volces.com.

The actual code makes credentialed HTTP requests to multiple third-party endpoints: the OpenCode Go quota endpoint opencode.ai (GO_QUOTA_URL at lib/index.js:520), the nine Coding Plan vendor endpoints (CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js, including api.anthropic.com, api.z.ai, open.bigmodel.cn, minimaxi.com/minimax.io, api.moonshot.cn, api.kimi.com, openrouter.ai, api.siliconflow.cn, api.commandcode.ai, and open.volcengineapi.com), and the user-configurable custom Provider balance endpoint (lib/custom-balance.js, whose request headers support substituting credential templates from the host credential store/environment variables).

For all these requests, credentials are only sent to each vendor's fixed official endpoint; balance queries are explicitly restricted to official domains only (balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js).

evidence.zh: package.json:49-56 的 dshhub.permissions.network 仅列 4 个域名；lib/index.js:520 的 GO_QUOTA_URL = 'https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage'；lib/coding-plans.js:846-877 的 CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS 白名单；lib/custom-balance.js:99-120 的 queryCustomBalance 用户可配端点与请求头模板；lib/index.js:739-748 的 balanceEndpoint 仅允许官方域名。
evidence.en: dshhub.permissions.network at package.json:49-56 lists only 4 domains; GO_QUOTA_URL at lib/index.js:520 = 'https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage'; CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS whitelist at lib/coding-plans.js:846-877; queryCustomBalance user-configurable endpoint and request header template at lib/custom-balance.js:99-120; balanceEndpoint at lib/index.js:739-748 allows only official domains.

impact.zh:
依赖权限声明判断插件联网范围的用户会低估其外联面：插件在启用对应功能后可访问多家第三方余额/额度接口并携带对应厂商的 API Key，而清单声明只列了 4 个域名。

触发条件：无需特殊条件，插件按配置启用余额/额度查询功能即会发起外联；自定义 Provider 端点需用户自行配置 URL 与请求头。

定级依据：未发现任何凭据被发往非官方端点或恶意外联，所有请求均与声明业务（费用统计与额度查询）自洽，属于权限声明不完整而非恶意行为，故定 LOW。
impact.en:
Users who rely on the declared permission to judge the plugin's network reach will underestimate its outbound surface: after the corresponding features are enabled, the plugin can access multiple third-party balance/quota interfaces and carry each vendor's API key, while the manifest declares only 4 domains.

Trigger condition: no special condition required; the plugin initiates outbound requests as soon as balance/quota query features are enabled per configuration. Custom provider endpoints require the user to configure the URL and request headers.

Rating basis: no credential was found to be sent to non-official endpoints or to any malicious outbound destination. All requests are consistent with the declared business (cost statistics and quota queries). This is an incomplete permission declaration rather than malicious behavior, hence rated LOW.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 清单、依赖与名称均正常，无仿冒或异常身份信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity review passed: dsh manifest, dependencies, and name are all normal; no counterfeit or anomalous identity signal.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：4 条预扫命中逐条核查，全部为良性（发版脚本、文档演示页、CI 工作流），运行时源码无危险执行模式。
summary.en: Static scan completed: the 4 pre-scan hits were each reviewed and all are benign (release script, documentation demo pages, CI workflow). Runtime source code contains no dangerous execution patterns.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装期钩子、无混淆载荷，凭据读取与网络外联均与声明业务自洽。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install-time hooks, no obfuscated payloads; credential reads and network outbound connections are consistent with the declared business.
